title: The energy-critical stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation: well-posedness and blow-up
summary: We investigate the focusing and defocusing energy-critical stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation, subject to random perturbations in the form of either additive or multiplicative (Stratonovich) noise. We establish local well-posedness for random or deterministic initial data $u_0$ in $\dot{H}^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$ or $H^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$, depending on the noise type. In the focusing case we provide quantitative estimates regarding the existence time and probability.
